listing_text:
🏷️ Shimano 28" Front Wheel w/ Dynamo Hub DH-C3000-3N-NT
📦 Item ID: #WF05
💰 Price: 250 DKK

🚲 Compatibility: Standard 28" (700c) city and trekking bikes with 100mm front dropouts and rim brakes (Includes Shimano dynamo)

📝 Description:
Shimano 28" front dynamo wheel featuring a Shimano DH-C3000-3N-NT dynamo hub (6V - 3.0W). Silver aluminum rim with an internal width of 19 mm, drilled for Dunlop/Schrader valves. True, smooth bearings, and in very good cosmetic and working condition.

🔧 Technical Specifications:
• Compatibility: Standard 28" (700c) city and trekking bikes with 100mm front dropouts and rim brakes (Includes Shimano dynamo)
• Wheel Size: 28" / 700c (622 mm)
• Position: Front
• Hub: Shimano DH-C3000-3N-NT Dynamo (6V-3.0W)
• Axle Type: Solid Axle (Nutted / Bolt-on)
• Inner Rim Width: 19 mm
• Brake Type: Rim Brake
• Valve Hole: Dunlop / Schrader

🚴 Ready to inspect and pick up in Copenhagen. Shipping available upon agreement.
